definitions.full: H5185. nacheth [ נָחֵת ] adjective descending ; — masculine plural נְחִתִּים (on form compare Kö ii. 81 ), 2Kin 6:9 (to battle); but read probably with Th Klo Benz after נֶחְבִּים ᵐ5 hidden .
